thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up — AcmePay just bumped the SIG/CAIQ response and asked for a bespoke attestation around KMS/HSM and audit log proof. They want: (1) KMS key rotation cadence + signed proof, (2) HSM attestation summary for our dedicated customers, (3) audit log retention/export evidence for last 12 months. They gave a hard deadline of next Friday EOD. Also, they reported an API 401 for a service account earlier today and a billing spike tied to a job that retried a failed request — so this is now an operational + security ask. Can SRE/Privacy help compile artifacts and triage the 401? Attaching logs below.

kevin_sre: on it. can you drop the raw logs and the account id? i'll triage the 401 and look for retry loops. also need to know if this customer is on Dedicated or Hosted.

maria_cs: account: acmepay-prod-42, customer on Dedicated with Reserved capacity. logs (redacted keys) below:
```
2026-03-12T14:22:01Z acmepay-prod-42 svc:auth request_id=abc123 user=svc-invoice status=401 "invalid signature"
2026-03-12T14:22:03Z acmepay-prod-42 svc:billing job=retry-batch attempt=1 cost.tokens=2345
2026-03-12T14:22:05Z acmepay-prod-42 svc:auth request_id=abc124 user=svc-invoice status=200
```

maria_cs: curl repro that customer sent (401):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd-XXXXX" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"test"}'
```

kevin_sre: that looks like a transient signing issue — maybe short-lived creds. i'll check our auth service traces for that request_id and see why svc-invoice got a 401 then 200. if retries from the job caused double-processing, that could explain billing spike. i'll open an internal incident and post link.

deploy-bot: Incident created: CS-2026-847 — Investigate AcmePay 401 + billing spike. Assigned to kevin_sre. https://redwood.inc/CS-2026-847

olivia_privsec: FYI on the SIG/CAIQ bespoke asks: for KMS/HSM we can provide our KMS architecture doc + HSM vendor attestation (redacted). For Dedicated customers we have a customer-specific HSM attestation summary (no raw certs in CS channel). Audit logs: default retention for Dedicated is 12 months for enterprise plan; Hosted default is 90 days. For export evidence we can provide an S3 export manifest (signed) and a sample of exported logs for the requested window. Need to confirm: do they want PKI-level signatures or just exported log manifests + chain-of-custody statements?

maria_cs: they specifically asked for signed proof of rotation and an HSM attestation they can file in their compliance folder. also want to see evidence that audit logs were immutable for the 12-month period.

ken_runtime: tagging in runtime — for rotation proof we can generate key rotation ledger entries from KMS audit trail (hash, rotation timestamp, actor). For immutability proof we can provide the append-only ledger snapshots and a digest signed by our key. i can prepare an export bundle. will need a PO/approval to include signed digests in customer artifacts — Olivia, is that okay from privacy/legal? we shouldn't expose internal HSM keys obviously.

olivia_privsec: approved to share signed digests and HSM attestation summary. legal wants all PII redacted and a short cover letter stating what we're sharing and limitations. i'll draft the cover letter. Also: please avoid attaching the raw HSM cert chain in channel; use secure share (Vault/secure-s3).

sam_billing: on the billing noise — i pulled the billing ledger for acmepay-prod-42 between 2026-03-12 14:00 and 15:00: there were 3x duplicate token charges caused by a job that retried the same request after a 401. I've opened billing case BILL-3012 to credit duplicates pending a root cause. cc @kevin_sre for root cause so we can process refunds.

kevin_sre: found the auth service trace for request_id=abc123. root cause: our token cache expired early due to a clock skew on one node in the auth cluster; the service returned 401 briefly and the client retried. i've created a fix patch to add a 10s leeway to token validation and scheduled a config rollout to Dedicated clusters. patch ID: rwd/auth-fix-10s-leeway.

kevin_sre: remediation plan: (1) roll the fix to auth-prod (scheduled in 30m), (2) backfill metrics and look for other nodes with clock drift, (3) give billing team list of duplicate request_ids for credit. ETA for steps 1+3: 4 hours.

maria_cs: great — can we also get a checklist of items to include in the SIG package and an estimated time to deliver the signed artifacts? customer wants delivery by next Friday.

olivia_privsec: checklist draft:
- cover letter (legal-approved) explaining scope & limitations
- KMS rotation ledger (signed digests) covering last 12 months
- HSM attestation summary + vendor attestation (redacted)
- audit log export manifest + sample logs (signed)
- confirmation of immutability process (append-only ledger explanation)
- contact for follow-up & escalation
I can draft these and put artifacts in a secure customer share. ETA: 2 business days to assemble and legal review 1 day => deliverable by Wed, which meets next Friday. if SRE needs to generate digests, add 1 day.

ken_runtime: i'll generate the rotation ledger digests and the append-only snapshots tonight and push them to secure-s3://acmepay-artifacts/ with restricted ACL. Will tag olivia_privsec when done.

deploy-bot: Reminder: runbook step executed: create-customer-artifact-share for acmepay-prod-42. Link: https://secure.redwood.ai/ars/acmepay-prod-42

maria_cs: perfect. kevin — once you have the list of duplicate request_ids can you paste them here (or to BILL-3012) so Sam can process credits?

kevin_sre: yes. duplicate request_ids: ["abc122","abc123","abc125"]. i've also added a note in CS-2026-847 with root cause and patch ID.

sam_billing: got them, starting credits. i'll keep you posted once refunds are queued.

olivia_privsec: quick note for the deliverable: don't include internal IP addresses in artifacts. redact to hostname level. legal requires that. :memo:

maria_cs: thanks all. i'll update the customer that we're assembling artifacts, ongoing incident for the 401 is open, and billing credits are being processed. will post the final share link when ready. :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: closing loop — auth rollout completed, config applied, monitoring alerting added for token validation failures. will keep CS-2026-847 in monitoring until EOD.

maria_cs: closing thread for now — will reopen if customer has follow-ups.
